summary: A weekly pre-order lunch box service with rotating menus.

idea_overview.problem: Office workers in Abu Dhabi may find consistent healthy lunches difficult to arrange.
idea_overview.solution: A weekly pre-order lunch box service with rotating menus.
idea_overview.impact: Potential benefit: make healthy lunches easier to arrange; test this assumption.
idea_overview.evidence: No customer interviews are recorded; these are assumptions to test.
idea_overview.why_market: The selected market contains the proposed segment; interview office workers in Abu Dhabi to test local fit.
